title: MA in Education
about: Azim Premji University's two-year, full-time MA in Education, offered at its Bengaluru and Bhopal campuses, combines theory, fieldwork, research and policy engagement. Round 1 applications for 2027 close 20 November 2026, followed by a National Entrance Test on 20 December.
requirements: Selection through the National Entrance Test (20 Dec 2026) and personal interviews (4-8 Jan 2027)
Offered full-time over two years at the Bengaluru and Bhopal campuses

upskill.name: AI Fundamentals for Education
why: Field "Education" and programme content "theory, fieldwork, research and policy engagement" → objective "Explore practical opportunities for AI across teaching, learning, assessment, student support, research, and academic administration."

Programme focus on education practice → objective "Identify educational activities that can be enhanced through AI while recognizing where educator expertise, pedagogical judgment, and human interaction remain essential."
